steps.title: LINEAGE RULE ON ITS OWN — only C's grant module is removed from OPA; G's is still there and G is denied

G's grant module is still in OPA (GET -> 200)
C's grant module is gone (GET -> 404)
G is denied (403) although its own grant is live: the lineage is broken
the resource audited the deny for G

steps.title: TTL ATTENUATION — G asks for 600 s from a C that has under 35 s left

checks.description: G's vend (ttl_seconds=600) succeeded: 201
G's expires_at equals C's (1794190537)
G's SPIRE entry expiry (1794190537) does not exceed C's (1794190537)
G's X.509-SVID TTL (25 s) does not exceed expires_at - issued_at (25 s), far below the requested 600
the vend event records the requested 600 s in detail.reason and the effective expires_at
the policy engine's own vend event says the TTL was shortened
G reads datasetA before C expires: 200
G is denied (403) once C's expiry has passed, with no DELETE
the resource audited the post-expiry deny for G
the reaper disposed C (ttl_expired, attributed to the vending service)
the reaper disposed G (ttl_expired, attributed to the vending service)
ttl_seconds=21601 is refused: 400
the refusal is audited (attest/deny: ttl_seconds 21601 exceeds the maximum of 21600)

steps.title: DEPTH LIMIT (default 2) — G may not vend

checks.description: G's vend is refused: 403
audited vend/deny naming the limit: delegation depth limit: the child would be at depth 3, but MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH is 2
no SPIRE entry was created for the depth-3 child
no vend/allow event, so no grant and no row exist for it

steps.title: DEPTH LIMIT variant — MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH=3: the very same manifest (same nonce) now succeeds

checks.description: vending service restarted with MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH=3
201 with the nonce that the refused vend carried: it was never recorded
a SPIRE entry now exists for the depth-3 child
P revokes C
the depth-3 child was revoked by the cascade, three levels below C's parent
its SPIRE entry is gone
vending service restarted: MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH=2 MAX_LIVE_CHILDREN=2
child 1 vended: 201
child 2 vended: 201
P's third live child is refused: 403
audited vend/deny naming the limit: live children limit: the caller already has 2 live children and MAX_LIVE_CHILDREN is 2
no SPIRE entry exists for the refused child
P disposes one child
the refused manifest (same nonce) now succeeds: 201, so the refusal left no nonce behind

denied at expires_at: 403

steps.title: OPA REACH — a pod labelled app=vending-service cannot open a TCP connection to OPA

checks.description: probe pod disposal-vs-probe (app=vending-service) is Running

control: app=policy-probe -> OPA:8181 connects (curl exit 56; the TLS handshake is what stops it), so the timeout above is the NetworkPolicy
